rationale: A is more complete and operationally sound, especially around observable cancellation, GPU-memory cleanup before readmission, resumable logs/events, conditional polling, artifact handling, request correlation, and explicit compatibility policy. B is clear and makes several good simplifying choices, but it omits same-key/different-body idempotency handling and cancellation cleanup guarantees, contradicts itself by showing a queued cancellation response while saying queued jobs transition immediately to cancelled, and incorrectly implies DELETE is not idempotent. A has minor flaws—such as a nonsensical queue position on rejected submissions and an inaccurate explanation of what idempotency-key conflicts catch—but provides the more actionable and failure-aware design.
